liquid.pour.title: Pour to sort
liquid.pour.body: Tap a tube to lift it, then tap another tube to pour. You can pour onto the same color, or into an empty tube. Fill each tube with just one color.

twist.hidden.title: Mystery layers
twist.hidden.body: A frosted ? layer hides its color. Pour away what sits on top of it and the color is revealed.

twist.lock.title: Locked tubes
twist.lock.body: A tube with a padlock tag cannot be used yet. It opens as soon as the color on the tag is finished in another tube.
